goal: Production operator-level prediction and aggregated/PD parallelism search for the supplied GLM-5.2 ModelSlim W8A8 checkpoint on Ascend910C.
authorization: 2026-10-22 user explicitly authorized producer/consumer adaptation, both nodes, missing-data collection, search/PD integration and per-stage local commits.

phases.deliverable: Typed Ascend precision/communication identities, exact consumer contracts and complete collection coverage manifest
Framework-selected operator/module collection and correctness/repeatability on source-matched hardware
Canonical Rust FPE model composition, lookup, diagnostics and source-qualified memory
Measured aggregated and PD forward/request validation including KV handoff
Native predict/recommend searches over supported TP/attention-DP/EP/PP and PD replica ratios with coverage diagnostics

missing_data.missing: Model-specific weight scales, token/head/TP grids, unquantized router/indexer/lm-head paths; exact static/dynamic identity

missing_data.present: 4 indexer +4 sparse attention controls; real TP8 trace
missing_data.missing: Full/skip modules, MLA BMM, norm/RoPE/cache, actual active/padded sequence metadata, additional TP/ADP and cached-prefill grids

missing_data.present: 6 balanced synthetic GMM controls; real dispatch/combine traces
missing_data.missing: Actual per-expert group lists, skew/empty-expert cases, activation fusion, dispatch/combine correctness and phase-specific EP paths
Strict transport/dtype/rank-placement/execution identity; full-payload SUM correctness and stable eager/graph curves for2/4/8/16/32ranks
Per-configuration resident weights/scales, HCCL/workspaces/graphs, indexer sharing KV representation, runtime reserve and PP ownership

missing_data.present: Same-SuperPod P2P bandwidth and latency; earlier deployment scripts
missing_data.missing: Pinned-runtime actual KV payload/packing, sender/receiver rank mappings, transfer overlap, receiving reservation and end-to-end validation

missing_data.present: One8k/1k serving control and repeated operation traces
missing_data.missing: Independent full-forward measurements across batches/contexts and deployment candidates; serving TTFT/TPOT/throughput comparisons

hccl.rules: No HCCL-as-NCCL labels; no fallback to another transport, precision, placement or graph mode; unmeasured rank tuples fail. Interpolate measured payload brackets only until extrapolation is validated.

w8a8.rules: INT8 weights/activations, distinct static/dynamic scale paths; BF16 attention/KV/router remain separate. Do not label as weight-only INT8 or FP8.

scope_limits: 32 available runtime devices total; memory feasibility must precede search. The checkpoint payload is720.708GiB including disabled/replicated components, not per-worker resident memory.
Peer driver differs from serving driver; keep provenance cells separate and validate transferability before sharing curves.
Unmeasured topologies and larger node counts cannot be presented as measured-optimal results.
Formal direct-FPM onboarding acceptance remains separate from operator-level integration; do not fabricate accepted profiles.
